data.gender_notes: Nazaarat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who observes and sees things, often with a deep understanding and insight. The name Nazaarat carries the meaning “Observer, Seer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Nazaarat usually hope their child will grow to embody observer, seer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a person who is a seeker of truth and knowledge, always observing the world around them and gaining deeper understanding and wisdom.
data.etymology: Nazaarat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Observer, Seer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazaarat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: نظراة

in_urdu.name: نظراة
in_urdu.long_meaning: نظراة ایک ایسا نام ہے جو خوبصورتی اور حسن کی نگاہ کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں گہری معانی رکھتا ہے، خصوصاً جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان، جہاں یہ حسن اور جمال کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नज़रात
in_hindi.long_meaning: नज़रात एक ऐसा नाम है जो सुंदरता और حسن की दृष्टि को दर्शाता है, और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में गहरी आध्यात्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व रखता है, जहां यह नाम सौंदर्य और अच्छाई का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: نظراة
